fields.title: Socios.com record
fields.description: The dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Chiliz's own field shape. One POLL row per fan vote with its results already counted, PARTNER rows for clubs, FAN_TOKEN and VOTE_TOKEN rows for the token catalogue, LEAGUE / SPORT / COUNTRY rows for the reference tables, and ERROR rows on failure. Chiliz adds and removes fields without notice, so fields not listed here pass through instead of failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The club, token or table this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-chiliz-acl for real records, none on error rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: POLL, PARTNER, FAN_TOKEN, VOTE_TOKEN, LEAGUE, SPORT, COUNTRY or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: partner_not_found, forbidden_by_acl or request_failed.

question.title: Question
question.description: POLL rows: the question put to fans.

partnerName.title: Club
partnerName.description: The club, esports org or brand that ran the poll or owns the token.

partnerShortName.title: Club short name
partnerShortName.description: Three-letter club code, for example ACM.

status.title: Status
status.description: POLL rows: opened, closed, cancelled, error and so on. PARTNER rows: active, inactive or created.

type.title: Type
type.description: POLL rows: engagement, integrity or prediction. PARTNER rows: sport_teams, esport_teams, brand, events or league_tokens. FAN_TOKEN rows: voteToken, nonDecimalVoteToken, externalToken, fiat, crypto or polygon.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: POLL rows: every option with its own totalVoteTokensUsed and votePercentage, plus isCorrect and hasWon on settled prediction polls.

answerCount.title: Answer count
answerCount.description: Computed. How many options the poll offered.

leadingAnswer.title: Leading answer
leadingAnswer.description: Computed. The option with the most vote tokens behind it, so the result is readable without opening the answers array. Null on a poll where nothing has been cast yet.

leadingAnswerVotes.title: Leading answer votes
leadingAnswerVotes.description: Computed. Vote tokens cast for the leading answer.

leadingAnswerPercentage.title: Leading answer %
leadingAnswerPercentage.description: Computed. Chiliz's own percentage for the leading answer, as a number.

totalVoteTokensUsed.title: Total votes cast
totalVoteTokensUsed.description: Computed. Vote tokens summed across every answer. On an open poll this runs ahead of usedTokenCount, which counts only what the chain has confirmed.

isDisclosed.title: Result disclosed
isDisclosed.description: Computed. Whether Socios has published the poll's outcome.

closeAt.title: Closes at
closeAt.description: POLL rows: when voting closed or will close.

quorum.title: Quorum
quorum.description: POLL rows: the participation threshold the vote needed.

currentQuorumPercentage.title: Quorum reached %
currentQuorumPercentage.description: POLL rows: how much of the quorum has been met.

isQuorumReached.title: Quorum reached
isQuorumReached.description: POLL rows: whether the vote cleared its quorum.

usedTokenCount.title: Tokens used
usedTokenCount.description: POLL rows: Chiliz's own count of vote tokens spent.

blockchainAddress.title: Poll contract
blockchainAddress.description: POLL rows: the on-chain address the vote was recorded at.

tokenSymbol.title: Token symbol
tokenSymbol.description: The club's fan token ticker, for example $ACM.

smartContractAddress.title: Token contract
smartContractAddress.description: Computed on FAN_TOKEN rows: the token's contract address on its primary network.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Computed on FAN_TOKEN rows: decimal precision on the primary network.

logoUrl.title: Logo URL
logoUrl.description: Computed on FAN_TOKEN rows: the token's logo on assets.chiliz.com.

description.title: Description
description.description: The club's or token's own description text as Socios publishes it.

tokenSupportingPlatforms.title: Listed on
tokenSupportingPlatforms.description: PARTNER rows: the exchanges that list this club's fan token.

mainColour.title: Club colour
mainColour.description: PARTNER rows: the club's brand colour as a hex code.

leagueIds.title: League ids
leagueIds.description: PARTNER rows: leagues this club belongs to. Resolve the names with reference mode.

sportName.title: Sport
sportName.description: Computed on LEAGUE rows: the sport this league belongs to.

countryName.title: Country
countryName.description: Computed on LEAGUE rows: the league's country.
